cases.prompt: Fuzz the C extension in our Ruby gem `fastcsv` with Ruzzy on a Linux box.

any.why: installs the gem with fuzzer instrumentation

expectations: Installs the gem with clang and CFLAGS including `-fsanitize=address,fuzzer-no-link`.
Sets ASAN_OPTIONS with allocator_may_return_null=1, detect_leaks=0 and use_sigaltstack=0.
The harness lambda rescues Ruby exceptions, returns 0 and is passed to Ruzzy.fuzz.

cases.prompt: Fuzz a pure Ruby method `Semver.parse` with Ruzzy on my MacBook.

all.why: uses a tracer script for pure Ruby

expectations: Says Ruzzy supports Linux only and suggests the Docker image or a Linux environment on macOS.
Uses two scripts: a tracer that calls Ruzzy.trace on the harness file, and the harness that calls Ruzzy.fuzz.
